name: codemagic
title: Codemagic
description: Codemagic REST connector (mobile CI/CD builds + apps). Read-only; surfaces build status, workflow id, branch and commit so the local index can correlate mobile CI runs back to PRs and incidents.

tools.name: codemagic_list
tools.description: List Codemagic resources. When `appId` is omitted, returns the user's accessible apps via `/apps`. When `appId` is provided, returns the app's recent builds via `/builds?appId=<id>` (limit optional).

tools.name: codemagic_get
tools.description: Fetch a single Codemagic resource. When `buildId` is provided, returns the build via `/builds/<buildId>`. When omitted, returns the app via `/apps` filtered to `appId`.

tools.name: codemagic_search
tools.description: Substring search across a Codemagic app's recent builds. Matches the query against `branch`, `message`, `workflowId`, and `status` (case-insensitive). Returns a `{ matches: [...] }` envelope.
